metadata.publication_status: Final Community Group Report, 1 June 2021; not a W3C Recommendation
metadata.rule_id_policy: MX40-PROSE- plus stable semantic slug; does not depend on row number
metadata.scope: All 642 annotations of six pinned XSD modules; the complete 974-page pinned 4.0 HTML corpus was inventoried and its normative prose reviewed, with explicit exclusions for old-version history and illustrative code/data. External normative dependency closure is separate.
metadata.coverage_claim: complete scoped MusicXML 4.0 prose corpus review; not a proof of complete transitive external standard validation
metadata.quote_policy: No verbatim passages reproduced in deliverables. Rules are paraphrases with exact source locators.
metadata.implementation_status: Research artifacts only. No Go code, tests, product or repository changes.
